questions.q: Where is Dr. Anubhuti's Dental Clinic located?
questions.a: Our studio is located at Dr. Shirish Gupta Nursing Home, 116, Civil Lines, Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh (Main Road, Near ICICI Bank & Circuit House Crossing).

questions.q: What dental treatments do you specialize in?
questions.a: We provide comprehensive dental care including Painless Root Canals, Dental Implants, Clear Aligners, Teeth Whitening, Cosmetic Smile Makeovers, Pediatric Dentistry, and Emergency Dental Care.

questions.q: Are procedures like root canal or tooth extraction painful?
questions.a: Not at all. We utilize modern computer-assisted local anesthesia, micro-endodontic technology, and gentle techniques to ensure all procedures are completely comfortable and virtually painless.

questions.q: How do I schedule an appointment with Dr. Anubhuti?
questions.a: You can easily request an appointment online through our booking form, call our clinic reception at +91 8126399924 / 8076601314, or reach our emergency desk at +91 7417499433.

questions.q: Do you offer emergency dental care for severe pain?
questions.a: Yes, we reserve priority emergency slots daily for severe toothaches, broken teeth, or sudden dental trauma. Call our emergency hotline at +91 7417499433 for immediate guidance.

questions.q: What are your clinic operating hours?
questions.a: Our studio is open Monday to Saturday from 10:30 AM to 2:00 PM (Morning) and 7:00 PM to 8:30 PM (Evening). Sunday care is available by prior appointment for emergencies.
